result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **I'd recommend HubSpot CRM** as the best all-around starting point. It's relatively easy to use, has a generous free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're primarily managing sales, customer relationships, marketing, or all three.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free starting plan (up to 2 users)
- Contact and deal management
- Email tracking and sales pipeline
- Marketing and customer service integrations

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting an all-in-one platform.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive | Marketplace Red Cactus](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IRFkfHYVKMpS2NXrRHE5xQL0_0qOqMxZ9tZ7IGfuLgaAd6FUoWTIN74_tGZqEXqWBstcAfVvix5tSwWCh_Z9jpsxIf_mFz50_GOJKyrc87_-7A9-hZKPxIv5_eq3RLE179FfxUm2MozwClA0LFh60tHrn4H8CNx2XDlT_R6fcmbJlEDJEuSbC8bnWGykfEEG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline
- Easy deal tracking
- Sales activity reminders
- Good reporting and automation

**Best for\:** Teams actively selling products or services.

Starts around \$14 USD/user/month with annual billing. [Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Strong customization
- Workflow automation
- Contact and lead management
- Integrates with Zoho business applications

**Best for\:** Budget-conscious teams wanting more advanced features.

Free for up to 3 users; paid plans from around \$14 USD/user/month annually. [Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone, email and chat features
- Lead scoring
- Sales automation
- Customer communication tracking

**Best for\:** Teams doing lots of customer outreach.

Growth starts around \$9 USD/user/month annually. [Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rL9Bzm932Es-G8eSD-IugxH25VpIFj2GrnbBExwUqA2Nr3S2F-13Q2QUuWHSsw5hSYAN9ENyOY_MTevU9OZtOiwp-cUhvAnLAqY_40r6pFQsW3KxPgFxL3JCosxfn4L6Jfwp2NCZNME-i2pDOLdg2P_TmFE26A6QIif7ztMuqYUxcMfuJMeKmmPBjbxzqwot?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Highly visual interface
- Customizable workflows
- Sales and project tracking
- Good team collaboration

**Best for\:** Teams managing sales alongside projects and operations.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

Pricing is approximate USD pricing, generally based on annual billing. Verify current Canadian pricing, taxes and plan limits before purchasing. ## Which one would I choose?

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Small business, general CRM | HubSpot |
| Sales-focused team | Pipedrive |
| Tight budget | Zoho |
| Lots of calls and emails | Freshsales |
| Sales + project management | monday CRM |
